smc.threshold: Auto Threshold enabled; cumulative native-history delta
smc.removal: literal low < raw.bottom bullish or high > raw.top bearish, evaluated before new formation

ifvg.flip_and_invalidation: min(open,close) or max(open,close) per direction; no wick-only flip
ifvg.display_limit: drawings only; source signal calculation still considers logical queue

runtime: closed native TF inputs; does not copy provisional/repainting intrabar drawings
limitations: Finite native feed history and cumulative seed must match when comparing chart detection. Closed native candles, not provisional intrabar drawings. Inactive records retained as evidence. Source-dependent formation/deletion corrected; liquidity capture and trade management unchanged. Annual context is on-demand and cannot create a new trade thesis.

ob.filter: ATR200, Wilder seed including initial high-low
ob.show_last: drawing limit does not expire active logical records
ob.execution_observation: first geometric retest preserved; same-bar deletion/eviction marked unresolved, no fill assumed

internal_structure.extra_condition: internal pivot differs from confirmed same-side external pivot
internal_structure.confirmation: actual close crossover/crossunder; rejected crosses do not change bias

annual.role: read-only context map, no signal authorization
annual.data: contiguous complete 12-month UTC calendar years only
